source:
if test "$#" -ne 2; then
    printf 'Usage: triage OWNERS EVENTS\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
registry=$1
events=$2
if test -f "$registry"; then true
else
    printf 'Owner file is missing.\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
if test -f "$events"; then true
else
    printf 'Event file is missing.\n' >&2
    exit 2
fi
declare -A owners
row=0
while IFS= read -r entry || test -n "$entry"; do
    row=$((row + 1))
    if printf '%s\n' "$entry" | grep -Eq -- '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*\|[^|]+$'; then true
    else
        printf 'Invalid owner row: %s\n' "$row" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    device=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d '|' -f 1)
    case "$device" in
        ?????????????????????????????????*)
            printf 'Invalid owner row: %s\n' "$row" >&2
            exit 2
            ;;
    esac
    owner=$(printf '%s\n' "$entry" | cut -d '|' -f 2)
    if test -n "${owners[$device]}"; then
        printf 'Duplicate device: %s\n' "$device" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    owners["$device"]="$owner"
done < "$registry"
reported=0
skipped=0
row=0
while IFS= read -r event || test -n "$event"; do
    row=$((row + 1))
    if printf '%s\n' "$event" | grep -Eq -- '^(INFO|WARN|ERROR)\|[a-z][a-z0-9-]*\|[^|]*$'; then true
    else
        printf 'Skipped row %s: malformed event\n' "$row" >&2
        skipped=$((skipped + 1))
        continue
    fi
    level=$(printf '%s\n' "$event" | cut -d '|' -f 1)
    device=$(printf '%s\n' "$event" | cut -d '|' -f 2)
    case "$device" in
        ?????????????????????????????????*)
            printf 'Skipped row %s: malformed event\n' "$row" >&2
            skipped=$((skipped + 1))
            continue
            ;;
    esac
    if test "$level" = INFO; then continue; fi
    message=$(printf '%s\n' "$event" | cut -d '|' -f 3)
    owner="${owners[$device]}"
    if test -z "$owner"; then
        printf 'Unassigned row %s: %s\n' "$row" "$device" >&2
        skipped=$((skipped + 1))
        continue
    fi
    printf '%s|%s|%s|%s\n' "$level" "$device" "$owner" "$message"
    reported=$((reported + 1))
done < "$events"
printf 'Reported: %s\nSkipped: %s\n' "$reported" "$skipped"
if test "$skipped" -gt 0; then exit 1; fi
exit 0
